name: tpl-precedence-3-nogoal
task: Do not take the key until you have moved the ball away from the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a pure restriction, 'do not take the key until the ball has been moved', with no commanded goal, so the single hard Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) is exactly right: has_door_key is barred until the first blocker_moved, the ban lifts once the ball has been moved (matching the 'until a' reading, and b's description holds no 'while still closed' condition that would make it an Absence), the hard priority matches the categorical 'Do not', and the rule-only machine with empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

texts: The agent must not be carrying the door key before the blocking ball has been moved away from the door.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !blocker_moved&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, blocker_moved) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !blocker_moved&has_door_key, u1) -> -10
